title: nothing private leaks into any answer - publication state and audience stay separate, role never widens scope

scenario.narrative: Caregiver fx_caregiver_1 asks what mom noted about tomorrow's pickup. The envelope carries a smuggled reference to fx_entry_private_001 - draft publication state, parents-only audience, visibleToActor false for this caregiver. Two independent exclusion reasons (publication state draft; audience not including the caregiver), never fused into one, and the failure leaks neither the draft's content, nor its title, nor which id exists - only the typed reason. Role never widens scope: a caregiver asking does not turn a private record visible.

envelope.utterance: what did mom note about tomorrow's pickup?
